globalMean.general: This is the average over the whole globe, not the value at one place.
globalMean.expert: Mean of the whole global grid, weighted by cos(latitude), land and ocean together where the product covers both. Not a point value.

region.general: This is the average of all the grid cells inside this data area ({{bbox}}), not the value at one place. Each data product has its own cell size, so a small area may hold only one or two cells.
region.expert: Area mean over the data area {{bbox}} (a bounding box, not a border), as returned by the data provider's averaging service. Products differ in resolution; a small area may contain only one or two cells.
